<function name="HUDShouldDraw" parent="WEAPON" type="hook">
	<description>This hook determines which parts of the HUD to draw.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="element" type="string">The HUD element in question</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return false to hide this HUD element</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
